 Selena Gomez and Jimmy Kimmel Tease Martin Short About Meryl Streep Amid Dating Rumors: 'I Wonder Why She Keeps Coming Back'
 Olivia Callanan Updated 2026년 11월 20일 금 오후 3:40 UTC 0 Selena Gomez and Martin Short appeared as guests on the November 19 episode of Jimmy Kimmel's show. BY: MEGA Selena Gomez and Jimmy Kimmel had a little fun at Martin Short 's expense!
 The Only Murders in the Building costars appeared on Jimmy Kimmel Live! on Thursday, November 19, to discuss the Hulu mystery comedy-drama's upcoming sixth season , which premieres December 8.
 However, the conversation also turned to Short's rumored romance with actress Meryl Streep , with the Rare Beauty founder and late-night veteran teaming up to tease the 76-year-old.
 'I Don't Know Why She Keeps Coming Back'
 Meryl Streep has starred in 'Only Murders in the Building' for four seasons. BY: @MARTINHAYTER_/X "Did you have scenes with Meryl Streep?" Kimmel asked Gomez.
 She replied, "I did, yes. Yeah. I get so geeked out," as the host questioned, "Do you really?"
 "Yeah, it's been so long. We've worked together for a while," Gomez continued.
 Short jumped in to share that "It's her fourth season."
 "Yeah, I don't know why she keeps coming back," Gomez teased as she side-eyed Short .
 'Is She Coming to Dinner Tonight?'
 Selena Gomez seemingly revealed that she and Martin Short were meeting up with Meryl Streep. BY: @MARTINHAYTER_/X Short confessed, "I don't know either, yeah."
 "It's another mystery," Kimmel added.
 "But it makes me unbelievably happy ," Gomez gushed. "You know, they say, 'Don't meet your heroes,' but if she's one of them, she's just everything."
 "You know her Wikipedia back and forth, then," Kimmel continued.
 "Oh, my gosh, let's not creep her out if we're going to dinner," Gomez said. "I don't want to go to dinner, and she sees this."
 Kimmel, looking for more details, replied, "Oh, is she coming to dinner tonight? Is that happening?"
 Advertisement
 "No, no," Gomez tried to retract her statement.
 'We're Being Cagey'
 Jimmy Kimmel joked that he was going to take pictures of the rumored couple having dinner together. BY: MEGA "Where are you guys going? What's the plan?" Kimmel continued to pry. "
 You know who doesn't like In-N-Out?" quipped Short.
 "It is kind of interesting to have you here, and everybody so interested in your personal life," Kimmel said to the Disney Channel alum. "And yet with Marty, we're being cagey right now, you know? It's quite a role reversal."
 "What's it like with the paparazzi and Marty? I mean, is that hard to deal with?" he continued as Short laughed. "This is it. We're done. We're done with the interview."
 Short, however, saw his opportunity to tease Kimmel right back: "Then what happens? What do you do then? After that, like, I know, you go to the buffet. We know that. But then what?"
 "I will be at the next table while you and Meryl are eating, taking pictures with my cell phone to sell to TMZ . That's what I'm doing," Kimmel joked.
 Martin Short and Meryl Streep Have Been Linked Since 2024
 In May, Martin Short and Meryl Streep had an intimate dinner in London. BY: MEGA The duo initially sparked dating rumors in August 2024 when they held hands at the Only Murders in the Building Season 4 premiere after-party in Los Angeles, Calif. A few months earlier, they sat together during the 2024 Golden Globes.
 "They are just very good friends, nothing more," Martin's rep confirmed at the time.
 More recently, in May of this year, the famous duo reignited romance rumors when they cuddled up next to each other at a restaurant in London.
 The stars sat close together during what looked like an intimate date night, according to a viral photo shared on X on May 17. In the snap, Streep leaned her head in toward the comedic actor as they looked at a phone.
